title: Jacques Vallée's control system: beings with us for thousands of years

tellings.quote: if you talk to Jacques Valle, he would say that they've been with us for thousands of years and they're sort of controlling like the earth in many ways

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes the view of a longtime UFO researcher named Jacques Vallée. Michels says Vallée would argue that non-human beings have been with us for thousands of years and are in many ways controlling the Earth. If true, it would mean the UFO story is not new at all but a very old presence shaping human life.
